name: Haru Chikamatsu
source:
Haru is the protagonist of the "Shadow-Saga" and a main character of the visual novels [url=http://vndb.org/v7879]Soulmates[/url] and [url=http://vndb.org/v10013]Sleepless Night[/url]. He also makes an appeareance in [url=http://vndb.org/v11975]Sleepless Night 2: Ladies' Night(mare)[/url].
He is a cheerful boy and a long sleeper.
